subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` wait for and cache-replay an accepted disconnected Gateway run before using the existing isolated embedded fallback, and what should happen when recovery cannot establish the original outcome?
rationale: This is a documented user-facing compatibility choice between prompt availability, latency, duplicate-side-effect avoidance, and authoritative-result recovery; code review cannot select that product contract.

options.title: Adopt recovery-first with isolated fallback
options.body: Make wait-and-cache replay the default after an accepted disconnect, then retain the existing fresh-session embedded fallback only after the approved recovery limit is exhausted.

options.title: Keep automatic fallback primary
options.body: Retain current main behavior and substantially narrow or close this PR if prompt return and continuity outweigh recovery-first behavior.

options.title: Fail closed after uncertainty
options.body: Require an explicit opt-in rerun after recovery fails, with an intentional CLI flag and complete upgrade and behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Adopt recovery-first with isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Make wait-and-cache replay the default after an accepted disconnect, then retain the existing fresh-session embedded fallback only after the approved recovery limit is exhausted.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged fresh-session fallback contract that this PR changes.
